title: Autism Acceptance Pack
description: A Small Resource Pack with various celebrational Autism Acceptance Logos.
body:
## Autism Acceptance Pack  ![Autism Acceptance Logo for this pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7203e01b335f22bfba6579ddca0e0f4433c9ad04.png)
The Autism Acceptance Pack is dedicated to educating and sharing information regarding Autism Acceptance. This currently has 3 things that help spread Awareness & Acceptance to all.

1. ∞ Has an Autism Acceptance Texture (Looks like This ![Autism Acceptance Logo for this pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7203e01b335f22bfba6579ddca0e0f4433c9ad04.png))
2. CIT Item for Logo & Glasses:
 - "Autism Acceptance Logo": Compass or Swords
 - "Autism Acceptance Glasses": Carved Pumpkin.

> These Items were developed originally for Skade Gaming with their Community Pack found exclusively on their server. For more information, go to [Skade Gaming's Website](https://skadegaming.com/)
